_what_this_is: The retrieval eval is the ONLY thing that can detect the VL_TEXT_GATE failure
mode, and it cannot run in CI: it needs the MLX VL server on Apple Silicon,
~21 min of ingest, and the operator's private compliance PDFs (not committed).
So this file records the last hand-run result together with a FINGERPRINT of
the inputs it was valid for. A unit test asserts the currently declared inputs
still match. That does not re-derive recall -- it makes the eval's staleness
impossible to miss, which is the actual defect: tau did not change when
diagram recall@1 fell 1.000 -> 0.714. The DATA changed underneath it.

fingerprint._note: Declared pins, not the installed venv -- tests/unit/test_dependency_drift.py already asserts venv == uv.lock, so the two together cover the live environment while this stays runnable on a CI box with no rag extra.

corpus.note: operator's private NERC CIP + OT policy PDFs; NOT committed

endpoint_tests._note: Both halves of the gate proven load-bearing on the docling index.

_read_this_before_trusting_chosen_tau: chosen_tau is the knee of the sweep AS MEASURED, on a query set that does not
represent the target use case (NERC CIP standards + operator policies, asked
about individually and against each other, conversationally). See P10 in the
report. Do not read it as evidence the system is fit for that use case.
scope_and_validity.query_set_bias: 21 of 37 scored queries are diagram_only and ALL target synthetic 2-page documents; the real corpus is 26 prose/table documents. VL_TEXT_GATE trades prose recall for diagram recall, so tau is fitted to a weighting production will not reproduce.
scope_and_validity.metric_limitation: scores a hit when ONE target_file ranks <= k. Compliance questions need the standard AND the policy together; source diversity is neither measured nor enforced.

known_bad_query.query: How does NERC CIP-002 categorize BES Cyber Systems as high, medium, or low impact?
known_bad_query.status: NOT in top 5 on the shipping configuration, at every tau
known_bad_query.not_an_extraction_failure: cip-002-5.1a contributes 121 chunks; 23 mention 'Attachment 1'; High/Medium/Low Impact Rating each appear in 3
known_bad_query.implication: the two options rejected on AGGREGATE score are the two that fix the most use-case-representative query; those rejections are PROVISIONAL

unmeasured: documents beyond RAG_MAX_PAGES=25 in the VISUAL arm (text arm always full)
conversational / follow-up queries (kb_search is single-shot and stateless)

rejected_provisionally._note: rejected on aggregate metrics from a biased query set; re-run before treating as settled
